research_question: Bank chatbot pilots that cite complaint deflection rates: what evidence actually supports replacing tier-1 human queues?
audience: Retail-bank ops and risk owners deciding whether to expand a chatbot pilot beyond a bounded queue.
scope: Use only the synthetic source pack attached to this task (disclosed as synthetic). Focus on deflection metrics, sample frames, escalation paths, and complaint outcomes. Do not reuse the original study brief text verbatim. No live web.
output_bounds: final.md, about 600–900 whitespace words as a deep memo: judgment, evidence discipline, counter-evidence, conditions that would change the call. Keep registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite deep memo retesting banking-chatbot evidence discipline; not a product comparison one-pager.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources only; do not treat vendor deflection % as proven replacement of tier-1 human queues; disclose synthetic materials and no independent review.
